meta.title: Firecrawl
meta.description: Connects an Agent to a Firecrawl instance through a native plugin: scrape a page into markdown or HTML, search the web and a developer index, map a site's URLs, crawl many pages and poll the job status, and parse local PDF, Office or HTML files. Point the plugin at your instance on its configuration page; the API key is stored in the credential store, not in the config.
